post.summary: Create a buffered or streamed text chat completion.
post.description:
Available when the gateway runs the local chat provider profile. Supply a TokenCraft bearer
key. A project key needs `requests:submit` and `requests:read`. With `stream: true`, replay the
same request body and idempotency key to recover the encrypted stream from the beginning.
A completed stream ends with `data: [DONE]`. Errors after the headers arrive are sent as a
JSON error frame followed by EOF. Follow `Location` to inspect the original request.

parameters.description: Stable key for this request intent.

parameters.description: Opaque application reference for usage and history.

parameters.description: Require a specific TokenCraft provider that the routing policy allows.

avatar.description: Their chosen avatar (custom upload, gravatar, or monogram).

created_by_user_id.description: Who minted it — resolve display info via `/v1/accounts/{id}/users`.

key_prefix.description:
Identifying prefix of the secret (`foundation_api_xxxxxx`) — the full secret is shown
only once, at creation.

message.description: Operator-set status/downtime message; null when all is quiet.
message.example: Scheduled maintenance 03:00–03:30 UTC — logins may be flaky.

ok.description: True whenever the API answered — reachability is the signal.

ArtCraftReference.description: ArtCraft preset used at import. The gateway operator supplies the routing price.

from.description: Previous value (business-name changes; null = placeholder was shown).

key_prefix.description: API key display prefix (key mint events).

superseded.description: A prior invitation was superseded by this one.

AuthSuccessResponse.description:
The logged-in response body: the user + their new session id (the token itself travels only
in the HttpOnly cookie).

AvatarInfo.description:
The avatar as APIs report it: the user's `preferred_source`, the derived effective `source`
(what actually displays), CDN links when an image backs it (`links` is `null` for the
letter/generated monograms — the client renders those itself), and the availability flags
the settings UI needs to offer choose/upload/remove/refresh.

oneOf.description:
Preview links for the custom upload, present whenever one exists (even when not
displaying) — the settings page shows all options side by side.

gravatar_checked.description: False while a gravatar (re-)poll is pending — the job hasn't checked yet.

oneOf.description: Preview links for the mirrored gravatar, present whenever one exists.

has_custom.description: A custom upload exists (choosable even when not displaying).

has_gravatar.description: A mirrored gravatar exists (choosable even when not displaying).

monogram_gradient.description: User-picked initials gradient slug (enums::MonogramGradient); null = default `brand`.

preferred_source.description: The user's stated choice; `NotYetSet` until they pick (the system auto-picks meanwhile).

source.description:
What's actually displaying: the preference when satisfiable, else the monogram. Never
`NotYetSet` (that's a preference, not a display).

AvatarLinks.description: Links to an avatar image on the CDN.

cdn_url.description: Direct link to the full-size image.

thumbnail_template.description:
Template for sized variants — replace `{WIDTH}` with the desired pixel width. In
development (no image resizer) this is simply the full image URL.

source.description: Typed via `enums::AvatarSource` — unknown values are rejected at deserialization.

AvatarResponse.description: Acknowledgement + the avatar as it now stands (source + CDN links).

limit_usd_nanos.description: Send null to clear the limit.

business_name.description: Null when unset — clients display `placeholder_business_name` instead.

email_verified.description: Always false after a change — verification resets.

current_password.description:
Required when a password exists. SSO-only accounts (see `/me`'s `has_password: false`)
omit it to SET their first password.

logout_other_sessions.description: Also revoke every OTHER session (bumps the session-version clock; this cookie re-mints).

max_completion_tokens.description: Defaults to 512 when no token limit is supplied.

max_tokens.description: Alias for max_completion_tokens. Supply only one limit.

messages.description: Plain-text messages, including at least one user message.

model.description: TokenCraft model alias configured in the chat catalog.

n.description: This endpoint accepts one completion per request.

stream.description: Select server-sent events instead of a buffered JSON response.

include_usage.description: Include a final usage event when both upstream token counts are available.

ComputeSelection.description: Operator-configured placement recorded at dispatch. Contains no destination or credential.

priority.description: Lower numbers have precedence. Ties are distributed by stable request hash.

settled.description: Comparable requests with a supplier settlement, including explicit zero amounts.

settled_usd_nanos.description: Sum of the latest posted amounts in decimal nano-USD.

description.example: Used by the render farm workers

secret.description: The full secret (`foundation_api_…`) — shown ONCE, never retrievable again.

join_url.description: The magic link carries the plaintext token (stored only as a hash).

store.description: Use stateless Responses semantics. The native request keeps its normal expiry.

client_ref.description: Limit deliveries to requests with this client reference.

destination_id.description: An ID from the operator's destination registry.

name.description: Display name with 1 to 80 characters after trimming.

workflow_app_id.description: Deliver terminal runs for one workflow application in this project.

processing_regions.description: Every region in which this offer may process request content.

oneOf.description: Identity named in the upstream response.

expires_at.description: Last instant before which this scoped quote can admit a new request.

pinned_offer_id.description: Exact offer pin to preserve when submitting this quote.

oneOf.description: Offer eligibility profile recorded when the request was admitted.

min_quality.description: Minimum community average. Applies to automatic model selection only.

min_usage_accounts.description: Minimum distinct organizations with a successful gateway request over the last 30 days.

model.description: A catalog model ID, or "auto" on the scoped gateway.

signing_secret.description: Store this signing secret securely. It is returned when issued.

access_token.description: Google: a token-client access token (custom-button flow) — alternative to `credential`.

code_verifier.description: GitHub: the PKCE verifier for that code.

impersonation.description: True when this is a staff impersonation session (auth.md §6).

sso_providers.description:
Connected SSO providers ("google", "github") — with `user.has_password`, the login-method
factoids the settings profile shows.

avatar.description:
The member's chosen avatar (custom upload, gravatar, or monogram — accounts.md §2),
resolved exactly as `/v1/auth/me` reports their own.

providers.description: Provider IDs of offers shared with the project and allowed by its routing policies.

gradient.description: Typed via `enums::MonogramGradient` — unknown slugs are rejected at deserialization.

access_token.description: Google: a token-client access token (custom-button flow) — alternative to `credential`.

code.description: GitHub: the authorization code from the web application flow.

code_verifier.description: GitHub: the PKCE verifier that produced the authorize request's `code_challenge`.

credential.description: Google: the GIS credential (ID-token JWT) from `google.accounts.id`.

state.description: One of pending, sending, delivered, or dead.

next_before.description: Cursor for the next page. Null when there are no more rows.
Cursor for the next page. Null when there are no more rows.

is_enabled.description: Password auth can never be removed once added (accounts.md §5), so there is no id here.

logout_other_sessions.description: End every existing session (the reset flow has no "current" session to keep).

code.description: The short human code — re-shareable from the console ("join with code").

invited_by_user_id.description: Who issued it — resolve display info via `/v1/accounts/{id}/users`.

step_id.description: Waterfall step containing the recorded evidence for this attempt.

available_after.description: Earliest retry time for an offer cooling down in this project.

model.description: Canonical model ID when comparing models automatically.

max_relative_error_bps.description: Allow the closest ratio with the same orientation, within this tolerance.

app_ref.description: Opaque application reference, retained in history and usage.

pinned_offer_id.description: Exact offer pin returned by the scoped quote.

RequestTraceDiagnosticPath.description: Routing evidence shared with support and the analysis model.

provider_path.description: Gateway attempts and the downstream provider reported by the upstream, when available.

ResolveInvitationResponse.description:
Everything the join page needs to branch (accounts.md §4): signed-in visitors confirm and
accept by `invitation_id`; signed-out visitors get login (`invitee_user_exists`) or a
signup form locked to `email`.

account_name.description: The inviting organization's name (unnamed accounts report `null`).

invitee_user_exists.description: A user already exists for the invited email → show login, not signup.

max_total_usd_nanos.description: Replace the saved per-request cost cap for this preview.

preferred_providers.description: Replace the saved provider order. An empty list uses estimated cost.

ScopedMediaRequest.description: Flat media request used with a scoped project bearer key in the local provider profile.

count.description: Output count. Images accept 1–8. Other media accept one output.

max_estimated_cost_micros.description: Whole USD micros. Alternatively use the x-tokencraft-max-cost-nanos header.

max_relative_error_bps.description: Image or video routing tolerance in basis points. Omit to use project policy.

model.description: A model ID, "auto", or "advise". Omission uses the account or project setting.

preferred_providers.description: Optional provider priority. An empty list selects by lowest estimated cost.

quote_id.description: Optional ID from a dry run on this route. The estimate must still be current.

created_via.description: How the session came to exist: `signup`, `invited_signup`, `login`, `sso_login`, ….

this_device.description: Marks the session making this request.

invitation.description:
An invitation code or magic-link token to redeem during signup (accounts.md §4).
The email must match the invite's email; the new user joins the inviting organization
instead of getting a personal one.

business_name.description: The new name; `null` (or blank) clears it, falling back to the placeholder.

display_name.description: New display name; empty/absent clears it.

cdn_url.description: Public CDN URL of the stored object.

file_id.description: Pass this in `image_inputs` / `mask` on the generation endpoints.

UserAuditLogItem.description: One row of a user's identity trail.

oneOf.description:
Event-specific payload — the typed union of everything we write
([`crate::audit_data::AuditData`]).

UserAuditLogsPage.description:
A page of user-trail rows. `next_before` is present only when the page was full (there may
be more) — pass it back as `?before=` for the next page.

UserBody.description:
The user as APIs report it. `avatar` is present on `/me` (omitted from the wire when None,
e.g. right after signup/login).

has_password.description: False for SSO-only users — the password form offers "set" instead of "change".

state.description: One of pending, sending, delivered, or dead.

RequestErrorResponse.description: Gateway rejection or HTTP request extraction error.

api_key.description: Account-scoped API key (`foundation_api_…`) — canonical form `Authorization: Bearer`; `X-API-Key`, `Authorization: Key`, bare `Authorization`, and Basic (key as username) are also accepted.

connector_completion_token.description: Request-bound completion token supplied to an opted-in connector.

session_cookie.name: foundation_session
session_cookie.description: HttpOnly session cookie set by signup/login
